name: select
title: Select
description: A form field with a floating label and a glowing focus halo that opens a dropdown anchored right under it — matching its width, preferring below, flipping above only when there's clearly no room, re-placing itself on resize / rotation / keyboard, and scrolling inside when long — or, with presentation="sheet", a drag-to-dismiss bottom sheet (a dialog on wide screens). The chevron turns, rows carry icons, descriptions, groups and disabled states, the chosen row gets a springy accent check, search highlights matches with a "No results" state, multiple mode adds checkboxes and removable chips that pop in and collapse out smoothly (overflow rolls into a "+N" chip, the footer count rolls too), and on web arrow keys, Enter and Escape drive the menu.
summary: A dropdown or sheet picker with a floating label; multi-select shows removable chips.
behavior: Tapping the field opens a dropdown anchored under it, flipping above when there's no room. presentation='sheet' slides up a bottom sheet you drag down to dismiss (a centred dialog on wide screens).
The label floats onto the border, a focus halo glows and the chevron turns. In multiple mode chips pop in and collapse out, overflowing into a '+N' chip.
On web, arrow keys move the highlight, Home and End jump, Enter picks, and Escape or Tab close the menu.
The field is a combobox whose value lists the selection, with an expanded state. Options are menu items, or checkboxes in multiple mode.
props: (T | { label, value, description?, icon?, group?, disabled? })[]
Plain values or rich options; `group` adds section headings.
Called when a row is chosen.
Checkbox rows; the menu stays open while toggling, with Clear / Done in its footer. The field shows animated chips plus a "+N" overflow chip.
Controlled or uncontrolled selection in multiple mode.
Called whenever a row is toggled in multiple mode.
Selections shown as chips; the rest collapse into a "+N" chip (0 shows a single "N selected" chip).
Show a ✕ on each chip in the field to remove it without opening the menu.
Set to false to put the label above the field as static text (no notch) and show placeholder inside.
Shown in the field while open with nothing selected.
Anchored dropdown under the field (flips above when needed) or a bottom sheet (dialog when wide).
Trigger height (44 / 54 / 64, matching FloatingInput), text, padding, radius and chevron size.
Filter field above the options with highlighted matches and an empty state.
Hint under "No results" when the search matches nothing.
Message under the field; errors shake once.
Colour behind the field (paints the label notch).
Minimum dropdown width; otherwise it matches the field.
Dropdown height cap before it scrolls (it also shrinks to the room on screen).
Style for the outer wrapper around the trigger field and message (the one that shakes).

The bordered box: background, border width / colour, radius, height, padding. Wins over the computed style; a borderColor replaces the resting border only (focus, error and success colours still show). A numeric height / borderRadius re-centres the label and resizes the halo.
Selected value / placeholder text in the trigger (single mode).

Label in both modes (floating and above). color is the resting colour — focus (accent), error and success still take over; fontSize sets the resting size, it floats at the same ratio and the notch follows its width.
Helper / error text. color applies to the helper; errors stay danger.
Chevron colour at rest (accent while open).
Dropdown / sheet panel — background, border, radius, padding, shadow (transform and opacity are animated).
Each option row — padding, minHeight, radius, background (press / keyboard highlight still show).
